title: Halo product feature
description: A product section on the paper background: a big two-line title, a short paragraph, a list of specs with small icons between hairlines and an orange button on the left; a large near-square photo on the right with a column of three small thumbnails (a row under the photo on phones).
notes: the thumbnails are a static strip: the first is marked, they do not switch the big photo
media and thumbnails are slots; empty they are muted placeholders
name: halodental-sonnet-product

props.name: title
props.description: the title; a list sets the line breaks

props.name: specs
props.description: spec rows with an icon each, divided by hairlines

props.name: media
props.description: the large photo. Empty shows the placeholder.

props.name: thumbnails
props.description: how many small thumbnails to show beside or under the photo (0 hides them)
